selected_evidence.summary: OpenRC reports the service started and enabled in the default runlevel; heartbeat timestamps advanced before and after reboot.
The live process root is /var/lib/inventory. Runtime data and heartbeat reside beneath its inventory-owned data directory.
Live process evidence shows NoNewPrivs=1, inventory uid/gid, and zero effective and ambient capabilities.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 176b736e-b7ca-45d1-8d46-f30cd6311206 to 5f67be1e-a6fd-415f-854b-9679481a26ef; service, confinement, privilege policy, and heartbeat recovered.

#!/sbin/openrc-run
name="inventory-worker"
description="Sandboxed inventory background worker"
pidfile="/run/inventory-worker.pid"
sandbox="/var/lib/inventory"

depend() {
  need localmount
  after bootmisc
}

start() {
  checkpath --directory --owner inventory:inventory --mode 0750 "$sandbox/data"
  ebegin "Starting $name"
  start-stop-daemon --start --background --make-pidfile \
    --pidfile "$pidfile" \
    --chroot "$sandbox" \
    --user inventory:inventory \
    --no-new-privs \
    --exec /bin/busybox -- sh /worker.sh
  eend $?
}

stop() {
  ebegin "Stopping $name"
  start-stop-daemon --stop --retry TERM/5/KILL/5 --pidfile "$pidfile"
  local rc=$?
  rm -f "$pidfile"
  eend "$rc"
}
